decisions.reason: Having remained on the market as a clearly positioned product line at the core of the firm's geospatial integration capabilities, it likely meets current aspiration levels and does not warrant reallocating resources away from it.

With the more GIS-specific identity offer already withdrawn, this authentication and delegation service has a clearer complementary role in enterprise GeoIT and is likely to be retained unless results now fall distinctly below aspiration.

The open GIS application development framework is tightly aligned with the firm's long-term platform strategy and solution business, so available organisational slack and strategic fit both favor keeping it.

As a newly launched consulting workshop that closely matches the firm's training and advisory capabilities, it is relatively low-cost to carry while demand becomes clearer and is therefore likely to stay on the market.
